user_agents.name: OAI-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Surface websites in ChatGPT search results
user_agents.scope: Web search crawl for ChatGPT search features

user_agents.name: GPTBot
user_agents.purpose: Training generative AI foundation models
user_agents.scope: General web crawl for training data collection

user_agents.name: OAI-AdsBot
user_agents.purpose: Validate safety of web pages submitted as ads on ChatGPT
user_agents.scope: Visits pages submitted as ads to check policy compliance

user_agents.name: ChatGPT-User
user_agents.purpose: User-triggered fetch for ChatGPT questions and Custom GPT interactions
user_agents.scope: User-initiated requests, not automatic crawling; may not respect robots.txt

user_agents.name: ClaudeBot
user_agents.purpose: Enhance utility and safety of generative AI models by collecting web content for training
user_agents.scope: Web crawling for training data collection from public web
user_agents.opt_out: Add 'User-agent: ClaudeBot' with 'Disallow: /' to robots.txt file

user_agents.name: Claude-User
user_agents.purpose: Support Claude AI users accessing websites in response to user queries
user_agents.scope: User-initiated web requests when individuals ask questions to Claude
user_agents.opt_out: Add 'User-agent: Claude-User' with 'Disallow: /' to robots.txt file

user_agents.name: Claude-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Improve search result quality by analyzing online content for relevance and accuracy
user_agents.scope: Web navigation to enhance search response quality for users
user_agents.opt_out: Add 'User-agent: Claude-SearchBot' with 'Disallow: /' to robots.txt file

user_agents.name: Googlebot
user_agents.purpose: Build Google Search index and support all Google Search features
user_agents.scope: General web crawl for search indexing; crawls desktop and mobile variants

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Image
user_agents.purpose: Index images for Google Images and image-related search features
user_agents.scope: Image crawls for Google Images, Discover, Google Video, and search image presentation

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Video
user_agents.purpose: Index videos for video-related search features and products
user_agents.scope: Video crawls for Google Search video features and dependent products

user_agents.name: Googlebot-News
user_agents.purpose: Index content for Google News product
user_agents.scope: News crawls for news.google.com and Google News app

user_agents.name: Storebot-Google
user_agents.purpose: Index products for Google Shopping surfaces
user_agents.scope: E-commerce crawls for Google Shopping tab and Shopping product

user_agents.name: Google-InspectionTool
user_agents.purpose: Support Search Console testing tools like Rich Result Test
user_agents.scope: On-demand fetches for Search Console testing and URL inspection

user_agents.name: GoogleOther
user_agents.purpose: Generic crawling for internal research and product-specific fetches
user_agents.scope: Miscellaneous crawls for various Google product teams

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Image
user_agents.purpose: Generic image fetching optimized for image URLs
user_agents.scope: Image URL fetches for internal Google product use

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Video
user_agents.purpose: Generic video fetching optimized for video URLs
user_agents.scope: Video URL fetches for internal Google product use

user_agents.name: Google-CloudVertexBot
user_agents.purpose: Support Vertex AI Agents building by site owners
user_agents.scope: Crawls requested by site owners for Vertex AI Agent training

user_agents.name: Google-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Manage content use for training Gemini models and grounding
user_agents.scope: Controls whether crawled content may be used for Gemini training and Vertex AI

user_agents.name: PerplexityBot
user_agents.purpose: Surface and link websites in search results on Perplexity
user_agents.scope: Search result surfacing; not used for crawling content for AI foundation model training
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow PerplexityBot in robots.txt file; configure WAF to block User-Agent containing 'PerplexityBot'

user_agents.name: Perplexity-User
user_agents.purpose: Support user actions and web page fetches when users ask Perplexity questions
user_agents.scope: User-triggered page fetches to provide accurate answers; not used for web crawling or AI model training data collection
user_agents.opt_out: Configure WAF to block User-Agent containing 'Perplexity-User'; generally ignores robots.txt but WAF configuration can block access

user_agents.name: Applebot
user_agents.purpose: Powers search technology in Spotlight, Siri, and Safari
user_agents.scope: General web crawling to index content for Apple search features across the ecosystem
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow: / in robots.txt for Applebot user-agent

user_agents.name: Applebot-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Determines how crawled data is used to train Apple foundation models and generative AI features
user_agents.scope: Secondary user agent that processes data from Applebot crawls for model training purposes
user_agents.opt_out: User-agent: Applebot-Extended / Disallow: / in robots.txt file

user_agents.name: iTMS
user_agents.purpose: Crawls URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts
user_agents.scope: Specific URLs registered with Apple Podcasts; does not follow robots.txt rules

user_agents.name: FacebookExternalHit
user_agents.purpose: Crawl shared content on Meta family apps to gather title, description, thumbnail
user_agents.scope: Content shared on Facebook, Instagram, Messenger; may bypass robots.txt for security checks
user_agents.opt_out: User-agent: facebookexternalhit / Disallow: / (may bypass robots.txt for security checks)

user_agents.name: Meta-WebIndexer
user_agents.purpose: Improve Meta AI search result quality and relevance of responses
user_agents.scope: General web crawl to enhance Meta AI accuracy and citation capability

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAds
user_agents.purpose: Crawl web for improving advertising and business-related products
user_agents.scope: General web crawl for advertising and business analytics

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAgent
user_agents.purpose: Train foundation AI models and improve products by indexing content
user_agents.scope: General web crawl for training data and product enhancement

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalFetcher
user_agents.purpose: Fetch links at user request to evaluate and improve agentic AI capabilities
user_agents.scope: User-triggered fetches to help AI navigate sites; may bypass robots.txt
user_agents.opt_out: User-agent: meta-externalfetcher / Disallow: / (may bypass robots.txt for user requests)

user_agents.name: msnbot

user_agents.scope: General web crawl for Bing search results

user_agents.name: Amzn-User

user_agents.scope: User-triggered fetch for live responses to answer customer questions

user_agents.scope: General web crawl to build Internet archive for research and analysis

user_agents.name: CCBot/1.0

user_agents.scope: General web crawl to build Internet archive for research and analysis
user_agents.opt_out: User-agent: CCBot / Disallow: / in robots.txt; also honors Crawl-delay parameter
